plugins.name: taskade
plugins.description: Use Taskade from your AI tool: import a spreadsheet into a project, fix a Taskade Genesis app, report on your projects and automations, back up an app, and plan a new app for Taskade EVE to build. Connects to the hosted Taskade MCP server with your Taskade login. The connection needs a paid Taskade plan. The Markdown and project view skills work with no connection.
